questions.question: Roughly how many English words are in 100 tokens?
questions.explanation: In everyday English, one token is about four characters, or roughly three-quarters of a word, so 100 tokens is about 75 words.

questions.question: When you ask a third question in a chat about a pasted document, what are you charged input tokens for?
options: The document, the earlier messages and the new question
questions.explanation: The model has no memory between turns, so the app resends the conversation, including the document, with every new message.

questions.question: Why might a model miscount the letters in a word?
options: It sees chunks of text (tokens), not individual letters
Counting is turned off to save money
It is trained only on numbers
The word is outside its context window
questions.explanation: Words are split into tokens before the model sees them, so tasks that depend on single characters can trip it up. Asking it to go step by step or use a tool helps.

questions.question: Which usually costs more per token?
questions.explanation: Most providers charge several times more for the tokens a model writes than for the tokens it reads.
